svg.title: Our wilderness creatures — step 5: Introduce your new friend
svg.desc: Give your creature a name, a home and an imaginary favourite food. Make a mossy bark friend, a leafy insect or a stone-and-leaf bird, then try your own idea. Photograph the finished arrangement while it is still flat.
